goalDecisions.independentReason: Opposite/alternate arrangement and shape jointly separate the four supplied plants; insect wing structure, legs and shell separate the four animals. Both missing-trait variations refuse an invented species identity. Identification remains explicitly confined to a reduced key rather than worldwide diagnosis.
goalDecisions.sourceCourseOperatorBoundary: BY12 GA/EA 3.1: identify animals/plants and appropriate working methods. No actual field observation claimed.

goalDecisions.independentReason: Flight-function grouping and hair/mammary homologies answer different questions. In O000/A100/B110/C111, m2 groups B/C and m3 is an autapomorphy; living A is not an asserted ancestor. Conflicting new molecular markers require homology and alternative-tree checks. Original/derived trait scope and the finite no-reversal premises are preserved.
goalDecisions.sourceCourseOperatorBoundary: BY12 GA/EA 3.1: compare historical/current ordering and assess explanatory value. Whole phylogeny reconstruction is a separate original partner duty.

goalDecisions.independentReason: Pre-exposure resistant variation contradicts a necessary contact-triggered useful mutation. The four culture counts do not identify mutation time or exclude horizontal transfer. The plant pair separates reversible environmental plasticity, heritable regulatory variation and limited epigenetic persistence. Neither universal acquired inheritance nor purpose-directed mutation is claimed.
goalDecisions.sourceCourseOperatorBoundary: BY12 GA/EA 3.2: assess mechanisms against current genetics. This is a constructed data analysis, not a performed fluctuation experiment.

goalDecisions.independentReason: Founder 14/20=0.70 versus 80/200=0.40 is random sampling, not evidence of selection. Different reproduction, mutation/recombination and reduced flow explain conditional divergence; 4/20 fertile crosses versus18/20 are not complete isolation. Host/time restriction and random bottleneck provide a genuinely different sympatric model. Restored mating can undermine barriers.
goalDecisions.sourceCourseOperatorBoundary: BY12 GA 3.2 whole interplay/speciation competence. EA primates are not made a mandatory GA condition.

goalDecisions.independentReason: Hypothetical primate fragments explicitly preserve mutation/recombination, drift, selection and flow without a ladder to humans. Equal-contribution mixture 0.8*0.2+0.2*0.8=0.32 is correct; sterile arrivals leave offspring-pool p=0.20. Survival without greater reproductive contribution is no established advantage; one marker does not define a species boundary.
goalDecisions.sourceCourseOperatorBoundary: BY12 EA 3.2 explicitly includes primates. Bounded EA material, no universal GA or other SekI primate-extension approval.

goalDecisions.independentReason: Food and shelter cases actually trace linguistic transmission between individuals, non-relatives and generations, combining information/coordination and cumulative improvements. Conditional reproduction and multiple causes of spread are distinguished from18/20 procedure success or8/14 model heat values. Wrong processing and warm-climate transfer defeat universal beneficial tradition/cultural hierarchy claims.
goalDecisions.sourceCourseOperatorBoundary: BY12 EA 3.2 cultural/social evolution, selection advantages and global spread. No archaeological measurements or measured fitness claimed.

goalDecisions.independentReason: Irrigation is immediate purposeful environmental change rather than purposeful plant allele creation/deletion. Breeding selects parents from heritable variation across generations. Water/salinity, narrow gene pool/disease and future variation limits are concrete; seed-bank variation is no guaranteed resistance. Human biological description is not a normative ranking.
goalDecisions.sourceCourseOperatorBoundary: BY12 EA 3.2 active environmental modification and risks, including pool change/overbreeding/social Darwinism.

goalDecisions.independentReason: Sibling help rB-C=0.5*3-1=+0.5 and changed B1 gives-0.5; unrelated r0 gives-1 under excluded reciprocity. Lifetime care5 versus6 reverses to7 versus6 under changed conditions. Costs/gains use the stipulated offspring-equivalent convention; energy or hatchlings are not silently equated with reproductive fitness. Animals are not said to consciously optimise.
goalDecisions.sourceCourseOperatorBoundary: BY12 GA/EA4 direct and indirect reproductive fitness. Finite modelling premises, not a universal explanation of altruism.

goalDecisions.independentReason: Own coded tables/time shares, net energy A6.5/B3, X2/Y5 and changed X7 are fully executable from supplied data. Fight proportions4/20=20% and1/20=5% are correct. Cooperation, threats and care are jointly interpreted with reproduction separated from energy/current young. Recoding proximity and safe repeated observation address validity and causation.
goalDecisions.sourceCourseOperatorBoundary: BY12 GA4 method application/cooperation/aggression/reproduction. Actual animal investigation and the entire chapter content union remain unclaimed.

goalDecisions.independentReason: A costs15/net5, B16.5/net1.5;80% versus20% response is association. Sender/signal/receiver/response and missing visibility are explicit. Event counts3 true,2 false,1 unannounced danger,2 safe-no-signal agree with all eight rows. Vigilance net1, threat cost difference4 and care1->3 are kept on distinct energy/reproduction scales; deception and learning remain hypotheses.
goalDecisions.sourceCourseOperatorBoundary: BY12 EA4 communication is the added course facet, not a mandatory GA extension. Methods are genuinely applied to complete synthetic logs.

goalDecisions.independentReason: Resources/rules are exogenous and hormonal/reproductive/stress state possible endogenous influences. Both cases separate proximate from unmeasured ultimate fitness hypotheses and expose rank/history/resource confounds. Human care/conflict adds learning, institutions and choices; no primate observation dictates an inevitable or morally correct role. Simultaneous food/rule changes do not identify one cause.
goalDecisions.sourceCourseOperatorBoundary: BY12 EA4 whole social-primate/critical-biologism competence. No clinical diagnosis or hormonal intervention.

goalDecisions.independentReason: Timeline values76.09/11.74/5.00cm and0.00652cm=0.0652mm fit100cm/4600Ma; human fraction0.00652%.600Ma window gives0.5mm.24h scale gives early life no later than05:44, diversification21:11, human start23:59:54.4;23:00 means191.7Ma. goalDecisions.sourceCourseOperatorBoundary: BY10 LB4 whole history-of-life/young-human competence; rounded references and model limits explicit.

goalDecisions.independentReason: Anatomical mammal/primate homologies plus explicit short synthetic molecular comparisons support the nested schema without pretending a full genomic tree. Humans/chimpanzees are living branches with shared ancestry. Bipedal function is convergent in the second card; individual inability to walk cannot change ancestry/species. Single conflicting locus requires broader quality-checked evidence.
goalDecisions.sourceCourseOperatorBoundary: BY10 LB4 anatomical and molecular human classification. Selected original RP/anatomical or genetic roles are partial, no immunobiological execution claim.

goalDecisions.independentReason: Nonoverlapping F1/F2/F3 intervals provide chronology but no proved ancestor chain. Overlapping F4 rejects a universal size ladder; tools do not identify maker or language. Forest/open observations and search preservation confounds constrain the exclusive savannah hypothesis without claiming a complete cause. Cultural farming/knowledge has current dietary/settlement and biosphere consequences, not newly inherited learned alleles.
goalDecisions.sourceCourseOperatorBoundary: BY10 LB4 fossil hypotheses/chronology/cultural significance. Separate RP ancestry-to-selected-behaviour and whole country course operators remain open.

goalDecisions.independentReason: Ash crystallisation is distinct from fossil age; conservative undisturbed bracket1.7-2.5Ma is correct. C14 is unsuitable for million-year-old volcanic ash. P:D1:3 under zero initial daughter/closed system gives two half-lives and2Ma; daughter loss increases P/(P+D), hence underestimates age. Reworking breaks the fossil bracket, and derived features/date do not prove direct ancestry.
goalDecisions.sourceCourseOperatorBoundary: Scientifically viable own fossil-evidence material. Original HE Q2.1.6 is not a literal current dating-methods clause; regional whole support not approved.

goalDecisions.independentReason: Equal reproductive mixture0.35, source-distance0.50->0.40, unequal contribution27.5/90≈0.3056 and future0.18 are correct. Sterile arrival changes demographics rather than offspring pool; immigrant-only reproduction does not prove crossing into the local lineage. Existing alleles, local disadvantage and isolation barriers prevent universal corridor/fitness/speciation claims.
goalDecisions.sourceCourseOperatorBoundary: Own whole migration/flow transfer accepted; literal current HE Q1.1.9 and mandatory LK placement remain source HOLD.

goalDecisions.independentReason: Expression location can affect stipulated segment identity while coding sequence stays unchanged. Hox is a network regulator, not a whole-animal solitary blueprint. Timing/enhancer versus growth-response convergence and temperature-only plasticity genuinely vary the premise. Inheritance, viability/fertility, selection and isolation each need evidence; sterile model line cannot propagate.
goalDecisions.sourceCourseOperatorBoundary: Own whole Evo-Devo transfer accepted; current HE homeobox support is optional Q1.5 LK, not literal mandatory Q2.2.7.

goalDecisions.independentReason: L/D/S cards are expressly didactic paraphrases, contrasting acquired need/use inheritance, pre-existing heritable variation/differential reproduction and modern genetics/drift/flow. Drift explains random neutral loss in the supplied selection-only contrast without falsely claiming all historical Darwin work omitted chance. Testable conditional B is separated from final-purpose A and untestable C without judging religion; one-generation epigenetics is not universal acquired inheritance.
goalDecisions.sourceCourseOperatorBoundary: BY12 GA/EA 3.2 supports Darwin/Lamarck and scientific/non-scientific distinction. Current HE Q2.2.1 literal numbering remains unverified; Q2.1 supports the broader mechanism.
